rule: A phone hello binds its node to the rostered player whose gun it names.
A lobby push retires earlier acknowledgements and preserves the players' READY choices.
Only a successful acknowledgement with a gun echo and the current config_id counts as current.
A lobby re-push issues a new config_id and retires acknowledgements for the previous head.
Updating counts READY bound players without a current acknowledgement, except players whose gun refused the head.
Coverage is full only when every bound phone is connected, joined through the tunnel and reports cellular.
START refuses a successful acknowledgement for an older config_id even with host override.
A LIVE row carries possibly_protected only while its phone is stale.
